title: Pacibook - AI Ebook Store and Reader for India
excerpt: Pacibook is an AI-powered ebook store and reader for India where readers discover, buy, download, translate, and read books in 22 Indian languages.
content_html:
AI-Powered Reading Companion

Read Any Book.In Your Language.

Pacibook is an AI-powered ebook store and reader for India. Discover and buy books, download them for offline reading, translate into 22 Indian languages, and ask questions as you read in real time.

Interactive Books

Read without changes. Content adapts to you, not the other way around.

Instant Translation

Translate complex passages instantly while preserving the author's voice.

Ask & Get Answers

Stuck on a concept? Ask the book questions and get immediate answers.

Browse by Category

No more barriers

Translate into 22 Indian languages with a single tap.

Pick a book

Open any title from the catalog.

Choose a language

Select Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, and more.

Enjoy reading

Toggle anytime. The original stays unchanged.

AI-generated translations are adaptive and never overwrite the book. Switch back to the original anytime.

Recommended for You

Viksit Bharat aur Jansampark

“Viksit Bharat aur Jansampark” (Developed India & Public Relations) is a timely Hindi edited volume curated by PRSI (Public Relations Society of India) - Wardha Chapter to support Hindi learners and practitioners in public relations and mass communication. The book frames the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision as a collective national journey - and explains how Modern PR can act as a catalyst by strengthening trust, enabling citizen participation, and making public communication clearer, faster, and more credible. It brings together essays across high-impact themes such as social media and analytics, AI, ethics in PR, CSR, politics/media communication, environment, health management, and agriculture development, positioning PR as strategic practice: storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and crisis management in a digital-first India.

by Dr. Rajesh Lehakpure, B.S.MIrge
